lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements comes before council — rules that directly shape how buildings go up in this canyon. Council also continues its work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program, while the Housing Authority moves to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee and the Open Space Commission walks the Valley Floor Monday afternoon to look at where a river trail might actually go.
